annotations.title: Get the link to book or buy

description: Get the link where the person books a service or buys a product on the seller's own site. Give date and time from check_availability and the booking form opens with that slot chosen. If the seller takes enquiries for this offer instead (kind enquiry), the link opens their enquiry form. Nothing is booked, held, charged or sent by this tool: give the person the link to finish there.

date.description: The day the person chose, from check_availability (YYYY-MM-DD).

offering_id.description: The service or product id from get_profile or search_people.

site.description: The person's ME3 handle or site address, as returned in `site` or `url` by search_people.

starts_at.description: Older form of date and time; prefer date and time.

time.description: The start time the person chose, from check_availability (HH:MM, the seller's local time).

name: start_booking
title: Get the link to book or buy
